metadata.datum: EGM2008 Ellipsoidal (SWOT) vs Local MSL / PWD

scientific_synthesis.core_finding: Empirical ablation confirms that adding satellite SWOT reach telemetry directly into point salinity regression does not reduce aggregate MAE (2.784 dS/m with SWOT vs 2.649 dS/m without SWOT) or peak MAE (2.923 vs 2.738 dS/m), because SWOT's 10-21 day orbital revisit aliases the 12.42-hour semi-diurnal tidal cycle.
scientific_synthesis.hydraulic_justification: SWOT's verified physical value in the platform is not unconstrained curve-fitting; it provides reach geometry (width, slope) and water surface elevation (WSE) required to evaluate gravity flap-gate drainage head (Delta_h = WSE_river - Canal_target) to prevent polder waterlogging.
scientific_synthesis.missing_swot_handling: When real-time SWOT telemetry is unavailable (clouds, orbital gap, or latency), the system smoothly defaults to the astronomical harmonic baseline without catastrophic degradation.
